description: Source file implementing a repository class for accessing and manipulating cart data in an e-commerce system using SQLAlchemy ORM. It provides methods to get cart items, find items by product options, create new cart entries, update quantities, delete individual items, and clear the entire cart for a customer.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Repository class for cart data access, encapsulating CRUD operations for cart items using SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: List[Cart] get_items(self, customer_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieve all cart items associated with a specific customer ID.

methods.name: Optional[Cart] find_by_product( self, customer_id: int, product_id: int, options: dict )
methods.description: Find a cart item for a customer based on product ID and options by matching serialized options data.

methods.name: Cart create( self, customer_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, options: dict )
methods.description: Create and persist a new cart item with specified customer, product, quantity, and options.

methods.name: None update_quantity(self, cart_id: int, quantity: int)
methods.description: Update the quantity of an existing cart item identified by its cart ID.

methods.name: None delete(self, cart_id: int)
methods.description: Remove a cart item identified by its cart ID.

methods.name: None clear_cart(self, customer_id: int)
methods.description: Delete all cart items associated with a specific customer.
